llm_fields.description: The scheme empowers Scheduled Caste leather artisans by enabling them to market their products through Lidkar Leather Emporia under the Lidkar brand, providing regular procurement based on showroom demand and helping them avoid exploitation by private dealers.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be leather artisans belonging to specified sub‑castes among the Scheduled Castes, be at least 18 years old, have an annual family income not exceeding ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas, must not have received benefits from other schemes except training programmes, and their family members should not be employed in government or semi‑government organisations.
